facts.value: Master the art of storytelling as an influential communication tool by earning an online Bachelor of Arts in English with a concentration in narrative studies from Arizona State University. This program will shape you into an analytical and creative storyteller who can recognize, interpret and craft stories that inform, persuade and inspire. You’ll graduate prepared for narrative-driven careers in media, design, marketing, public relations, political messaging and more.
